QuestInfo.name: The Battle Against Zeno
QuestInfo.0: The #b#p2050002##k, who has failed at keeping #o6220001# under control, informs you that #m221000000# will be in danger if nothing is done to control #o6220001# soon. Let's hurry over to #b#p2050001##k and let him know.
QuestInfo.1: When you told #p2050001# what you heard about #p2050002# from the Wave Translator, he asked you to defeat Zeno for the sake of the whole world. According to #p2050001#, #o6220001# can be found in #b#m221040400##k. You're the only one who can stop #r#o6220001##k!
QuestInfo.2: You have defeated #o6220001# and reported your progress to #p2050001#. Not only does #m221000000# have to worry about the safety of the world, but also the safety of the #p2050002#... No wonder #m221000000# is always busy.

0.0: Hm...so the Grays couldn't control Zeno. Looks like all their pride in their strict order comes to naught in the end. This is some good info. Thanks for your help.
0.1: Zeno will affect the Omega Sector too? We can't have that happen. I don't think that one Zeno can put the entire Omega Sector in danger, but It's better to be safe than sorry. We'll need your help again.

yes.0: Please defeat #rZeno#k for us. It'll be a piece of cake for someone as strong as you. Zeno makes frequent appearances in #b#m221040400##k. You can do it!

no.0: Are you declining this mission? Bummer. Shall I call the M-Forcers then...?

1.0: Ah, you've defeated Zeno. I really appreciate your hard work. I've been so fortunate to have met someone like you. We need you in the Omega Sector. What do you think about becoming the 5th M-Forcer? You will be in neon orange... Not your cup of tea?

yes.0: Please come back to see me if you want to become a M-Forcer. We'll be happy to welcome you whenever.

mob.0: You haven't dispatched #rZeno#k yet? In case you forgot, Zeno is in Kulan Field V.
